dates.name: Utah Lake Festival — Family Fun & Water Recreation
dates.desc: Celebrate the lake with cardboard boat races, paddleboard jousting, rock climbing wall, mini golf, and live music. Kids' activities, science demos, and shoreline strolls. Perfect outdoor date exploring the water and enjoying spring weather together.
dates.where: Utah Lake State Park — 375 W Center St, Provo, UT 84601 (25 min from SLC)

dates.name: Ballet West Spring Performances — Capitol Theatre
dates.desc: Stunning ballet performances by Utah's premier ballet company. Beautiful choreography, classical elegance, and world-class dancers. Perfect romantic, culturally enriching evening. Running May 13-16 at Capitol Theatre—pick your preferred evening.
dates.start: Evening performances (7:30 PM typical, check schedule)
dates.where: Janet Quinney Lawson Capitol Theatre — 50 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Comedy Night at Wiseguys — Nick Alex Stand-Up
dates.desc: Hilarious stand-up comedy with rising comic talent. Intimate comedy club atmosphere with great drinks and food. Perfect Friday evening of laughs, relaxation, and fun without the heavy commitment. Get there early to grab good seats.
dates.where: Wiseguys Comedy Club — 194 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Kilby Block Party 2026 — Epic Music Festival
dates.desc: Massive music festival with 70+ artists including Lorde, The xx, Turnstile, Modest Mouse, Father John Misty, Japanese Breakfast, Beach Bunny & more. Friday May 15 lineup is incredible. Outdoor stages, gourmet food vendors, craft beer garden. High-energy, discovery-focused festival experience.
dates.start: 11:00 AM gates open, performances until late
dates.duration: Full day (6+ hrs) or all weekend
dates.where: Utah State Fairpark — 155 N 1000 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84116

dates.name: Living Traditions Festival — Multicultural Food & Music
dates.desc: Free festival celebrating diverse cultures with international food vendors, craft beer & wine, live music & dance performances. Explore global cuisine, enjoy local artists, and soak in vibrant community energy. Great alternative if Kilby sells out.
dates.where: Washington Square / Library Park — Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Utah Dough Show — Donut Fest & Celebration
dates.desc: Ultimate donut festival with vendors, tastings, competitions, and fun activities. Local bakers, national donut brands, and creative creations. Live music, kids' activities, and plenty of samples. Perfect Saturday morning/afternoon of indulgence and exploration.
dates.where: Electric Park at Thanksgiving Point — 3003 Thanksgiving Way, Lehi, UT 84043 (30 min south)

dates.name: Utah Food Festival — Culinary Celebration
dates.desc: Sample amazing tastes from Utah's best local artisans and chefs. Attend workshops led by culinary experts, discover food history, and enjoy chef demonstrations. Perfect for foodies wanting to explore Utah's culinary scene together.
dates.where: Natural History Museum of Utah — 301 S 1300 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: Tulip Festival at Ashton Gardens — Final Days
dates.desc: Last chance to enjoy 1 million blooming tulips across 50 acres! Peak spring colors with live music (Fri-Sat), yoga classes (mornings), watercolor painting workshops, and scenic photo ops. Phenomenal outdoor date as festival wraps up for the season.
dates.where: Ashton Gardens — Thanksgiving Point, 3003 Thanksgiving Way, Lehi, UT 84043

dates.name: RIVERDANCE — The Iconic Irish Dance Experience
dates.desc: Electrifying Irish dance spectacular! Jaw-dropping choreography, thunderous percussion, and world-class dancers. Similar energy to live sporting events you love—but with artistic beauty. An unforgettable theatrical experience that'll move you. Multiple showtimes Fri-Sun.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Garden Bros Nuclear Circus — World-Class Circus Spectacle
dates.desc: World-class circus with Human Cannonball, Wheel of Death, Motorcycles in the Sphere of Fear, Human Slingshot, Chinese Acrobats, clowns & comedy. Modern climate-controlled Big Top with 60+ international performers. Non-stop action & entertainment!
dates.start: Weekday 4:30 PM & 7:30 PM | Sat 1:30/4:30/7:30 PM | Sun 1/4/7 PM
dates.where: Utah State Fairpark — 155 N 1000 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84116
dates.reservation: recommended (buy in advance for best prices)

dates.name: JB Smoove Stand-Up Comedy Show at Wiseguys
dates.desc: Comedy legend JB Smoove bringing high-energy stand-up! Hilarious stories, physical comedy, and crowd interaction. Friday-Saturday shows at the intimate Wiseguys Comedy Club. Perfect for a night of laughter and fun.
dates.where: Wiseguys Comedy Club — 194 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Kesha Concert — High-Energy Pop Show
dates.desc: Pop/rock performer with infectious energy and fan-favorite hits. High-energy show perfect for a fun Saturday night out. Outdoor amphitheater setting with food vendors and relaxed festival vibe.
dates.where: Utah First Credit Union Amphitheatre — 3861 W Concert Way, West Valley City, UT 84119

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Bison Herds & Wildflowers
dates.desc: Peak May wildflowers across the scenic 7-mile loop! Spot native bison, pronghorn, and bighorn sheep with Great Salt Lake backdrops. Spring colors everywhere. Perfect for exploration and nature photography. Bring insect repellent (gnats present in May).
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075 (40 min north)

dates.name: Kayaking at Bear Lake — Crystal Alpine Water
dates.desc: Pristine turquoise alpine lake surrounded by mountains. Peaceful, scenic paddle routes perfect for your love of water dates. Rent kayaks or paddleboards. Morning calm, golden hour romance, or sunset magic.
dates.where: Bear Lake State Park — Garden City, UT (1.5 hrs north of SLC)

dates.name: Ensign Peak Hike — 360-Degree City & Mountain Views
dates.desc: Quick 1.5-mile round-trip hike near downtown with spectacular views of Salt Lake City, Wasatch Mountains, and Lake. Accessible trailhead, short commitment, stunning vistas. Perfect for a morning or evening adventure.
dates.where: Ensign Peak Trail — 800 N Canyon Rd, Salt Lake City, UT (near downtown)

dates.name: Snowbird Aerial Tram — Hidden Peak Alpine Experience
dates.desc: Ride the 2,000-foot tram to Hidden Peak (11,000 ft) for 360-degree Wasatch views. Eat at the summit restaurant with alpine scenery. Accessible, romantic, unforgettable. Great alternative to hiking.
dates.where: Snowbird Resort — 9385 E Snowbird Tram Rd, Snowbird, UT 84092 (45 min east)

dates.name: Red Butte Garden — May Wildflower Stroll
dates.desc: Utah's premier botanical gardens in peak May bloom! Spring wildflowers, blooming trees, lush landscapes. Peaceful, romantic afternoon. Pair with nearby Natural History Museum for a full day.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Dinner at Handle — Park City Farm-to-Table Excellence
dates.desc: Chef-driven restaurant featuring Dave Jones' celebrated seasonal small plates. Chili-glazed vegetables, fresh seafood, heritage meats. Excellent wine list and intimate atmosphere. Sophisticated yet approachable.
dates.where: Handle — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon Escape
dates.desc: Scenic mountain location four miles up Millcreek Canyon with sweeping views. Chef Dave Jones' Southwestern-influenced menu, excellent wine, impeccable service. Romantic, upscale, just minutes from downtown.
dates.where: Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon, Salt Lake City, UT 84124

dates.name: Dinner at Courchevel Bistro — Classic French Cuisine
dates.desc: Authentic French bistro with signature baked brie, venison loin, steak frites. Romantic ambiance, excellent service, wine pairings. Perfect Park City date night escape.
dates.where: Courchevel Bistro — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at APEX — Montage Deer Valley Luxury
dates.desc: Elegant fine dining with sweeping mountain views. Exceptional steaks, fresh seafood, impeccable service. Expert wine pairings. Luxurious, memorable, unforgettable.
dates.where: APEX at Montage Deer Valley — Park City, UT (30 min)

dates.name: Dinner at Rouser — Downtown SLC Contemporary
dates.desc: Contemporary American cuisine with fresh, seasonal ingredients. Chef-curated tasting menus available. Sophisticated urban vibe in downtown SLC. Excellent cocktails and wine selection.
dates.where: Rouser at Asher Adams — Downtown Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Horseback Riding at Sundance — Mountain Trail Adventure
dates.desc: Guided horseback rides through scenic mountain trails with spring wildflowers and stunning overlooks. Beginner-friendly with experienced guides. Romantic, peaceful, unforgettable alpine experience.
dates.where: Sundance Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604 (45 min south)

dates.name: TopGolf at Vineyard — Games, Scoring & Food
dates.desc: Friendly competition in private bays with automatic scoring, full bar, and great food. Zero golf skill needed—just fun, laughter, playful competition. Relaxed, upbeat date night energy.
dates.where: TopGolf — 484 N Entertainment Way, Vineyard, UT 84059 (30 min south)

dates.name: Escape Room Challenge — Puzzle & Teamwork Fun
dates.desc: 60-minute immersive puzzle experience. Choose themed rooms (Egyptian Tomb, Heist, Zombie, etc). Solve puzzles together, race the clock. Great teamwork and problem-solving challenge.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Utah Symphony — Classical Masterworks & Film Scores
dates.desc: World-class orchestra performing classical music and film scores. Romantic, sophisticated, culturally enriching. Perfect for arts lovers. Check schedule for current spring offerings.
dates.where: Abravanel Hall — 123 W South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Natural History Museum of Utah — Fossils & Exhibits
dates.desc: World-class museum with 60,000+ bones/fossils, interactive exhibits, stunning valley views. Educational and fascinating. Pair with nearby Red Butte Garden for a full afternoon.
dates.where: Natural History Museum of Utah — 301 S 1300 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: Salt Lake City Gallery Walk — Arts District Exploration
dates.desc: Explore downtown SLC's vibrant arts district. Local artists, contemporary installations, rotating exhibits. Grab coffee, discuss art, discover new favorites together.
dates.where: Salt Lake City Arts District — Downtown SLC

dates.name: Craft Lake City — Local Artisan Marketplace
dates.desc: Browse and support local artists and makers. Handmade goods, art, crafts, unique finds. Live music, food vendors, vibrant creative energy. Perfect for discovering unique items and supporting Utah's creators.
dates.where: Salt Lake City (various seasonal locations)

dates.name: Scenic Railroad Dinner Train — Historic Journey
dates.desc: Ride historic trains through scenic Utah landscapes. Some routes feature dining cars with gourmet meals. Unique, romantic, nostalgic experience perfect for something distinctive.
dates.where: Various Utah train tours (check schedules)

dates.name: Salt Lake Brewery & Distillery Tasting Tour
dates.desc: Guided tasting tour of local craft breweries and distilleries. Sample locally crafted beers, spirits, and special offerings. Learn about the brewing/distilling process. Fun, educational, supportive of local makers.
dates.where: Various SLC-area breweries and distilleries
